subject: Human Body
title: The Rectum and Defecation
description: A fast breakdown of The Rectum and Defecation for builders.

hook.text: The final 15 cm of the digestive tract stores stool until your brain says it's an appropriate time.

buildup.text: The rectum has stretch receptors. When stool fills it, nerves signal the urge to defecate.

discovery.text: Two sphincters guard the exit: an internal one you can't control and an external one you can.

twist.text: Ignoring the urge repeatedly causes the rectum to stretch and weaken signals. Chronic constipation can follow.

climax.text: Defecation is a coordinated reflex refined by conscious control. Both parts must work for normal function.

punchline.text: One sphincter is automatic. One you trained as a toddler.

quiz.question: How many sphincters control the exit of stool?
options: Two: one involuntary and one voluntary
